verification.reason: Two high findings and one low finding.

findings.evidence: bottlebound_rules_final.md requires exact initiative ties to use a coin flip, but rollInitiative automatically shuffles every equal-total group with cryptographic randomness. The UI provides no coin-flip input or manual-order correction.
findings.violated: .codebox/standards.md makes bottlebound_rules_final.md authoritative and prohibits silent changes to normative gameplay resolution.
findings.issue: An exact tie can produce a console order that differs from the referee's required coin-flip result, so the console can run a different turn order from the rules contract.
findings.remediation: Either implement and record the rules-prescribed referee coin-flip result, or explicitly approve the digital tie procedure and update the authoritative rules and all duplicated summaries.

findings.evidence: The full-suite script runs Vitest and Playwright without building, while Playwright starts vite preview, which serves only the ignored dist directory. The recorded pnpm run test passed after pnpm run build left dist in the worktree; a clean checkout has no dist and cannot run this command successfully.
findings.violated: .codebox/constitution.md defines pnpm run test as the full-suite command, and acceptance criterion 24 requires a working full-suite pnpm command; test evidence must be deterministic and trustworthy.
findings.issue: The declared full suite fails from a clean checkout and can test stale production output left by an earlier build.
findings.remediation: Make the browser or full-suite command build immediately before vite preview, then check pnpm run test from a clean state.

findings.evidence: The new authoritative rules identify the game as BOTTLEBOUND, but README.md still identifies it as KAEVLE & DRAGONS.
findings.violated: .codebox/standards.md requires README.md to remain consistent with bottlebound_rules_final.md and to update when a rules change makes its summary inaccurate.
findings.issue: Repository readers receive a different game name from the authoritative contract.
findings.remediation: Change the README summary to identify the game as BOTTLEBOUND and keep its concise description consistent with the rules.

findings.evidence: A valid history containing SetupCreated, InitiativeGenerated, and InitiativeRerolled remains accepted if the third event's type is corrupted to InitiativeGenerated. The replay applies both initiative event types whenever the phase is Setup without checking whether initiative already exists, and replay still matches the unchanged snapshot.
findings.violated: Acceptance criterion 21 requires invalid saved data to produce a recovery error; acceptance criterion 9 requires replacement of an existing initiative result to use an InitiativeRerolled Match Event.
findings.issue: The implementation silently restores a semantically invalid event history instead of showing the required recovery error.
findings.remediation: During replay, require InitiativeGenerated only when Setup has no initiative result and InitiativeRerolled only when it already has one. Reject either event when its prerequisite is false, and add restore coverage for both corrupted transition types.

blockers: Choose whether the approved Generate-versus-Reroll event contract or the implementation is wrong before remediation starts.
